---
title: "Difference-in-differences for product and policy changes"
description: "A concise note on using pre/post comparisons with treated and comparison groups."
categories: [Difference-in-Differences, Quasi-Experiments, Panel Data]
---

## Core Idea

Difference-in-differences compares changes over time in a treated group to changes over time in a comparison group.

## What Makes It Credible

- Treated and comparison units had similar pre-treatment trends.
- The timing of treatment was not driven by an unobserved shock that also changed the outcome.
- There are enough pre-periods to inspect trends.
- The intervention did not spill over into the comparison group.

## Industry Uses

- City or market rollouts.
- Pricing or promotion changes.
- Product launches with staggered adoption.
- Policy changes affecting selected units.
